capabilities: Record lectures with live local transcription
Fetch and match course slides from Canvas or Moodle
Summarize transcripts with a local model
Link transcript paragraphs and timestamps to slides
Build course notes, review notes and flashcards
disambiguation: Not a general audio-to-text tool: it records or imports a lecture, then builds course notes, slide links and review notes around it.
extras: Desktop-only (starts a local whisper-server process, uses Node.js). The plugin does not download whisper.cpp itself; a setup checklist walks through installing it and the models. Optional opt-in flashcards use the Spaced Repetition plugin's Question::Answer format. Part of the Companion suite of local-first plugins by Tony Peonio.
problem: Obsidian has no built way to record a lecture, transcribe it on your own machine, and tie the slides and course notes to what was said.
